params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Continue'; $oc=(Get-Command opencode.exe -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); if(-not $oc){$oc=(Get-Command opencode -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)}; Write-Output ('OPENCODE=' + $(if($oc){$oc.Source}else{'missing'})); if($oc){ & $oc.Source --version; Write-Output '---paths---'; & $oc.Source debug paths; Write-Output '---ollama---'; try { (Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 5).models | Select-Object name,model | ConvertTo-Json -Compress } catch { Write-Output ('OLLAMA_ERROR=' + $_.Exception.Message) } }
